name: Maxon
description: '''Mason Jorge Reyes''' (June 16, 2004 – November 16, 2025), known professionally as '''Maxon''' (stylized in all lowercase; formerly as '''Maxon Margiela'''), was an American rapper and songwriter from [[Orlando, Florida]]. He began making music professionally in 2024 and rose to prominence later that year with the release of his singles "Austin Powers" and "Sexual Fantasies".
